dogecoin.text:
It’s easy to HOLD #Dogecoin when it grows every day. But it’s difficult to HODL when the price goes down. Wish all the holders strength! 

RT if your hands are strong and you are still holding!🔥

It might be Year of the Ox in China, but for the crypto world, it is the Year of the Dog.  

The Shiba Inu-based meme currency #dogecoin has zoomed 13,000% since the start of the year and is showing no signs of stopping. 

 via @Abhinavkaul
